verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows gstack documenting its own security posture. There is no first-party description of what skills may execute, no trust model for third-party or agent-written domain skills, and no telemetry disclosure. The only telemetry mention is a community comment saying usage telemetry exists with an opt-out, which is not project documentation. The /cso and /review skills audit the user's code, not gstack itself, and the learnings.jsonl note describes a feature rather than a data-collection policy.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, the project documents its security posture — what skills can execute, the trust model for third-party skills, and any telemetry or data collection
